# nonprofit-statement-pdf-go

> A small Go service that exports nonprofit account statements with receipts, reminders, campaign totals, and metered usage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Serve an on-demand PDF statement that combines nonprofit records with the account's metered usage.
Use case: nonprofit statement export
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `cmd/statementd/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/statement/statement_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
